For me, it's the only voice that matters. And that's why I'll continue to fight back. Fighting Through Legislation I continue fighting for Marylanders on the floor of the Senate, and I wanted to share just some of the legislation I have led or cosponsored over the last few weeks, including legislation that seeks to minimize the negative impacts on families and federal workers in the event of future lapses in appropriations. Healthy Maternal and Obstetric Medicine (MOM) Act This bill would ensure that all women eligible for coverage through the Affordable Care Act (ACA) insurance marketplaces, as well as women eligible for other individual or group health plan coverage, can access affordable health care coverage throughout their pregnancies. The bill would establish a special enrollment period (SEP) for expectant mothers. Currently, marriage, divorce, having a baby, adoption, and changing jobs are considered qualifying life events that trigger a special enrollment period; however, becoming pregnant is not considered a qualifying event. The Healthy MOM Act would change that. Federal Worker Mortgage Forbearance Act This bill would require 90 days of mortgage forbearance for federal workers and contractors with federally-backed mortgage loans. Shutdown Student Loans for Feds Act This bill would require the Department of Education to pause student loan payments for federal workers - including federal contractors and military personnel - in the event of a federal government shutdown lasting longer than two weeks. HELP Feds Act Ensures federal employees who are required to work during a government shutdown are eligible to apply for unemployment insurance. Boosting Benefits and COLAs for Seniors Act This legislation would direct the Social Security Administration to adjust benefits based on the Consumer Price Index for Americans aged 62 or older (CPI-E) rather than the Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners (CPI-W), if CPI-E would result in a larger increase in benefits, and; direct the Bureau of Labor Statistics to calculate and publish the CPI-E on a monthly basis. Voter Purge Protection Act This legislation would prohibit the removal of individuals from official state voter rolls due to changes in residence or not voting in previous elections, stipulate that only verifiable and objective evidence (such as a death or permanent move to other state) can result in removal from voter rolls, and require notification to registered voters about their removal and how to contest. Background Check Expansion Act This legislation would expand federal background checks to nearly all gun sales. Right to Representation for VA Workers Act This bill would codify VA employees' Weingarten right to be represented by a person of an employee's choosing during an investigation that may result in disciplinary action against the employee. The Weingarten right is a long-held principle protected through collective bargaining agreements. Anti-Cash Grab Act This legislation would repeal a provision--quietly added into the Senate government funding bill by U.S. Senate Majority Leader John Thune (R-S.D.) at the last minute--that allows senators to collect $500,000 for every phone record lawfully obtained. True Shutdown Fairness Act This legislation would have ensured pay for all federal workers, federal contractors, and our military during the government shutdown. Keep Head Start Funded Act This legislation would provide funding for Head Start programs during a government shutdown and prevent disruptions for children and families in need. Securing Assurance for Federal Employees Act This legislation would prohibit any federal agency from carrying out a reduction in force (RIF) during a lapse in appropriations, ensuring that federal employees cannot be permanently laid off during a government shutdown. Keep SNAP and WIC Funded Act of 2025 This bill provides FY2026 appropriations for the Department of Agriculture (USDA) to continue operating the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP); the Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC); and a related block grant program if there is a lapse in FY2026 appropriations for USDA. Emergency Relief for Federal Contractors Act This legislation would allow penalty-free distributions from retirement accounts in the case of certain federal contractors impacted by federal government shutdowns. Fair Pay for Federal Contractors Act This legislation would provide automatic backpay for federal contractors during a government shutdown. Restoring Access to Detainees Act This legislation would ensure that families can contact each other and lawyers have access to their clients when they come into ICE custody and when they are transferred between facilities. The bill would also codify portions of the current detention standards concerning detainee access to communications with oversight entities and would codify the free phone minutes program, ensuring that noncitizens can make outgoing calls. No Nuclear Testing Act This legislation would prohibit the use of federal funds for any explosive nuclear weapons test, while preserving stockpile stewardship activities consistent with the zero-yield standard. The bill reaffirms America's commitment to responsible nuclear policy and global arms control. Social Security Emergency Inflation Relief Act This legislation would provide economic recovery payments to recipients of social security, supplemental security income, railroad retirement benefits, and veterans disability compensation or pension benefits. No Argentina Bailout Act This legislation would stop the $40 billion bailout the Trump Administration is providing for Argentina. National Native American Heritage Act Resolution This bipartisan resolution recognizes National Native American Heritage Month and celebrates the heritages and cultures of Native Americans and the contributions of Native Americans to the United States. American-Speech-Language-Hearing Association Resolution This resolution commemorates the centennial year of the American Speech-Language-Hearing Association. SNAP During the Shutdown Resolution This resolution expresses the sense of the Senate that the Trump Administration is legally obligated to fund the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) through the use of the contingency fund (during the government shutdown). National Wildlife Refuge Week Resolution This bipartisan resolution designated the week beginning on October 12, 2025 as "National Wildlife Refuge Week." Navy 250th Birthday Resolution This bipartisan resolution recognized the 250th birthday of the United States Navy. Book Banning Resolution This resolution expresses concern about the growing problem of book banning, and the proliferation of threats to freedom of expression in the United States. In the Community It was such a joy to meet with Maryland high schoolers who came to visit me on Capitol Hill this week. These students came from all across our great state to discuss critical legislation and how I can best represent them. I reminded them they are our future. Their voices matter. It was a joy to join State Senator Nick Charles, Special Secretary Yolanda Maria Martinez, and the Prince George's Chamber of Commerce for a Fireside Chat to discuss how I'm fighting for our small businesses. It was great to have the opportunity to hear from Howard County residents alongside my colleagues Rep. Sarah Elfreth, Attorney General Anthony Brown, and Comptroller Brooke Lierman. Marylanders are sick of this Administration's cruelty and clear inability to govern. We will continue to fight back and stand strong for Maryland values. It was great to meet with Charles County leadership to hear more on their priorities on how they plan to continue moving the county forward. I was proud to partner with local leaders and direct federal funding for SMRT and their CSM aviation program. I was honored to join Pastor John K. Jenkins and other faith leaders for the Master Series of Distinguished Clergy at First Baptist Church of Glenarden. Together, we will continue the fight for a just future -- a future where we can all live safely, with dignity, and thrive. Stay in the Fight ** I know these are difficult times. But please know that I will continue fighting for you every step of the way. We will not give up. We will not give in to this Administration, and I ask that you continue to fight alongside us. Please continue to reach out to us. You can call the office or connect with us at . You can also follow us on Bluesky, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, YouTube, and X. We are in this TOGETHER. Sincerely, Angela D. Alsobrooks United States Senator

| | **“****A disproportionate number of illegal immigrants go to blue states, they amplify the effect of a blue state vote. My understanding is that Democrats would lose approximately 20 seats in the house if illegals were not counted in census. And that’s also 20 less electoral votes for president.**** ** **So, illegals absolutely do impact who controls the House and the presidency.”****~** Elon Musk
---
| | Fellow Conservative,Elon Musk is right. It isn’t rocket-science. It’s basic math. It’s also a ticking time-bomb set by Joe Biden and Kamala Harris – in the form of 11.5 million illegals entering our country on their watch – one which will explode shortly after President Trump leaves office in 2029.While you and I have no doubt President Trump will deliver on his promise to secure the border, this threat will not go away. The truth is, without immediate action, these illegal aliens will be counted in the U.S. Census, which determines both the apportionment of seats in the House of Representatives _and_ the number of electoral votes given to each state. Whether they came because, four years ago, Kamala Harris and Joe Biden prompted them to “surge to the border” for asylum or because of blue-states offering sanctuary status, “free” health care, “free” cell phones, “free” housing, and “free” college...it doesn’t matter. The result is the same.Your vote is _already_ being **watered down** in Congress. Your vote is _already_ being **watered down** in the Electoral College.And every day reports are popping up of non-citizens, illegal aliens, and convicted felons being registered to vote in cities and entire swing-states across the country, which means your vote may be fully **canceled out in future elections**. **_American elections should be decided by American citizens._****[If you agree then please sign your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution so the chaos we’re seeing now _never_ happens again in America.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2s3vjf5j0fop674b71cj852g72ja1bd0i7sav4g_rp22sh2s8i6eor6ctim8or2cth2bs)**Because, here’s the scary part:The last census took place in 2020. That was _before_ the 11.5 million illegal aliens who invaded our country under Joe Biden and Kamala Harris. To put it in context, there are only 8 states in America with a population over 11 million. So, it’s as if the radical Left just imported the 9th largest state in America. That’s more than North Carolina (10.8 million), Michigan (10 million), New Jersey (9.2 million), or Virginia (8.7 million).You get the picture. That’s why urgent action is needed to pass a Constitutional Amendment to ban illegal aliens from voting and from being counted for purposes of congressional and electoral vote apportionment. The next census in less than 6 years away. If those 11.5 million illegal aliens are counted in the census or are allowed to vote in the intervening years, you and I simply won’t have a country. **[It’s vitally important that your representatives in Washington and in your state legislature hear this demand directly from you.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zk1erb77bqrs4jt169c15vo0u8ibcanqajrbi05g_rp22sh2s8i6eor6ctim8or2cth2bs)** Because, quite honestly, they think they can pull a fast one on you. They think you and I will be so relieved to see the border secure again and criminal illegal aliens deported, that you and I will be oblivious to this threat lying dormant under our very eyes.No way.My name is Rebecca Weber. I’m the chairwoman of AMAC Action. **AMAC Action is the most influential advocacy group in the country when it comes to standing for the values of conservative Seniors.****We’ve got 72 chapters and 300 volunteer delegates, who are the “feet on the street” advocates who contact Members of Congress and state legislators in their district offices.** **Moreover, our chapters and delegates help organize Town Hall meetings with elected officials and candidates to enable those locally of our 2,000,000 AMAC members to meet, hear, and question them.****And you should also know that we now have more than 337,000 AMAC members who respond to our “calls-to-action” and weigh in with members of the** **U.S. House and Senate, as well as their state legislators on the issues.** Quite simply, when we speak, Washington listens. [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5qmo9kfudqv1qeo35qotu3r0d5p2gifaerdn8to_rp22sh2s8i6eor6ctim8or2cth2bs)**[And AMAC Action needs your help today in this do-or-die battle to pass a Constitutional Amendment to protect your vote from being canceled out by an illegal alien or a convicted felon.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8m5g9ko1vo814ag68593k64jhje4s0a3vhsj5l0_rp22sh2s8i6eor6ctim8or2cth2bs)** But I can’t do it without you. **No matter what issue you care about the most, if you and I don’t have a secure,_honest_ elections... none of it matters.**Inflation. Illegal immigration. Violent Crime. Drug use. Homelessness. The 2nd Amendment. Out of control spending. Social Security and Medicare insolvency. Right to Life. Indoctrination in our schools. Endless foreign wars. You name it. **[So please follow this link to sign your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zn9vcovv6k6adc0t4elt2sask4dojfhdc0i5a7do_rp22sh2s8i6eor6ctim8or2cth2bs)** so that AMAC Action can put your representatives in Washington and in the state legislature on notice with a simple demand: Namely, that you will not tolerate this erosion of your vote.Now, here’s the bad news:Most state constitutions grant voting rights to “every” citizen, open-ended language that liberal activists argue permits localities to authorize non-citizen and even illegal alien voting. States should amend their constitutions to instead permit “only” citizens to vote. But there’s good news, too:Seven states have _expressly_ banned non-citizen voting already: Alabama, Arizona, Colorado, Florida, Louisiana, North Dakota, and Ohio.**What’s more, voters approve of constitutional amendments to ban non-citizen voting by overwhelming margins. Nearly 77% of Ohio voters approved a measure in 2022, while nearly 63% of Colorado voters approved one in 2020.** This is a solution whose time has come. You and I can do this. **[That’s why, when you’ve signed your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zmbfumh7g64rv2phq8adc3mup1v46reo7ddnser0_rp22sh2s8i6eor6ctim8or2cth2bs), I'm also asking you to make a one-time contribution of $35 to give AMAC Action the resources to send out, collect, process, and tabulate millions of petitions.** The reality is, we don’t get a dime of taxpayer funding. Our funding comes from grassroots conservatives like you who care deeply about the future of America. This is important. _It means we can’t be bought._ On the other hand, the leftwing election fraud machine is funded by leftwing billionaires like Mark Zuckerberg and George Soros who are actively funneling _billions_ to dark money “non-profit” groups to “**reshape** ” our elections and our electorate.With that said, if you’re able to make a larger contribution – say $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, or even $1,000 – it would really be a life saver. Please hurry. In order to secure your vote in all future elections – and with 11.5 million illegals chomping to be included in the next census – **[your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution is vitally important.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zj2igvuu56qfekaus37lk2s7c6v528u5q53u5jf0_rp22sh2s8i6eor6ctim8or2cth2bs)** Yes, this is about saving your vote from being canceled. It’s also about saving America.And it all starts with the straightforward premise that non-citizens and illegal aliens – no matter how many Kamala Harris and Joe Biden imported on their watch – should be banned from voting _and_ banned from being counted for apportioning congressional seats and electoral votes. Thank you in advance for joining the fight to secure your vote

It’s also a ticking time-bomb set by Joe Biden and Kamala Harris – in the form of 11.5 million illegals entering our country on their watch – one which will explode shortly after President Trump leaves office in 2029.While you and I have no doubt President Trump will deliver on his promise to secure the border, this threat will not go away. The truth is, without immediate action, these illegal aliens will be counted in the U.S. Census, which determines both the apportionment of seats in the House of Representatives and the number of electoral votes given to each state. Whether they came because, four years ago, Kamala Harris and Joe Biden prompted them to “surge to the border” for asylum or because of blue-states offering sanctuary status, “free” health care, “free” cell phones, “free” housing, and “free” college...it doesn’t matter. The result is the same.Your vote is already being watered down in Congress. Your vote is already being watered down in the Electoral College.And every day reports are popping up of non-citizens, illegal aliens, and convicted felons being registered to vote in cities and entire swing-states across the country, which means your vote may be fully canceled out in future elections. American elections should be decided by American citizens., here’s the scary part:The last census took place in 2020. That was before the 11.5 million illegal aliens who invaded our country under Joe Biden and Kamala Harris. To put it in context, there are only 8 states in America with a population over 11 million. So, it’s as if the radical Left just imported the 9th largest state in America. That’s more than North Carolina (10.8 million), Michigan (10 million), New Jersey (9.2 million), or Virginia (8.7 million).You get the picture. That’s why urgent action is needed to pass a Constitutional Amendment to ban illegal aliens from voting and from being counted for purposes of congressional and electoral vote apportionment. The next census in less than 6 years away. If those 11.5 million illegal aliens are counted in the census or are allowed to vote in the intervening years, you and I simply won’t have a country. Because, quite honestly, they think they can pull a fast one on you. They think you and I will be so relieved to see the border secure again and criminal illegal aliens deported, that you and I will be oblivious to this threat lying dormant under our very eyes.No way.My name is Rebecca Weber. I’m the chairwoman of AMAC Action. AMAC Action is the most influential advocacy group in the country when it comes to standing for the values of conservative Seniors.We’ve got 72 chapters and 300 volunteer delegates, who are the “feet on the street” advocates who contact Members of Congress and state legislators in their district offices. Moreover, our chapters and delegates help organize Town Hall meetings with elected officials and candidates to enable those locally of our 2,000,000 AMAC members to meet, hear, and question them.And you should also know that we now have more than 337,000 AMAC members who respond to our “calls-to-action” and weigh in with members of the U.S. House and Senate, as well as their state legislators on the issues. Quite simply, when we speak, Washington listens. But I can’t do it without you. No matter what issue you care about the most, if you and I don’t have a secure,honest elections... none of it matters.Inflation. Illegal immigration. Violent Crime. Drug use. Homelessness. The 2nd Amendment. Out of control spending. Social Security and Medicare insolvency. Right to Life. Indoctrination in our schools. Endless foreign wars. You name it. so that AMAC Action can put your representatives in Washington and in the state legislature on notice with a simple demand: Namely, that you will not tolerate this erosion of your vote.Now, here’s the bad news:Most state constitutions grant voting rights to “every” citizen, open-ended language that liberal activists argue permits localities to authorize non-citizen and even illegal alien voting. States should amend their constitutions to instead permit “only” citizens to vote. But there’s good news, too:Seven states have expressly banned non-citizen voting already: Alabama, Arizona, Colorado, Florida, Louisiana, North Dakota, and Ohio.What’s more, voters approve of constitutional amendments to ban non-citizen voting by overwhelming margins. Nearly 77% of Ohio voters approved a measure in 2022, while nearly 63% of Colorado voters approved one in 2020. This is a solution whose time has come. You and I can do this. , I'm also asking you to make a one-time contribution of $35 to give AMAC Action the resources to send out, collect, process, and tabulate millions of petitions. The reality is, we don’t get a dime of taxpayer funding. Our funding comes from grassroots conservatives like you who care deeply about the future of America. This is important. It means we can’t be bought. On the other hand, the leftwing election fraud machine is funded by leftwing billionaires like Mark Zuckerberg and George Soros who are actively funneling billions to dark money “non-profit” groups to “reshape ” our elections and our electorate.With that said, if you’re able to make a larger contribution – say $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, or even $1,000 – it would really be a life saver. Please hurry. In order to secure your vote in all future elections – and with 11.5 million illegals chomping to be included in the next census – Yes, this is about saving your vote from being canceled. It’s also about saving America.And it all starts with the straightforward premise that non-citizens and illegal aliens – no matter how many Kamala Harris and Joe Biden imported on their watch – should be banned from voting and banned from being counted for apportioning congressional seats and electoral votes. Thank you in advance for joining the fight to secure your vote | | For Freedom, Rebecca Weber,ChairwomanAMAC Action | | | P.S. American elections should be decided by American citizens. It’s not rocket-science. And it shouldn’t be controversial. Yet, the radical left is pouring billions into their scheme to “reshape ” our elections and our electorate. This dangerous rollback denies science, enriches polluters, and puts our health, safety, and future at risk. [**Sign the petition and tell Congress to stand up to Trump on climate!**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf7f3119d-69f8-4daf-b1a5-c54235916300/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | It's been two months since I launched my campaign for Congress, and I've spent that time traveling across Western North Carolina—talking to Democrats, Republicans, and Independents. People who don't always agree on politics, but who love this place and care deeply about their families, their communities, and their future. What I've seen is clear: our people are tired. Tired of the fighting. Tired of the excuses. Tired of leaders who talk about helping everyday folks while spending their time helping themselves. We know the difference between right and wrong. We know what leadership looks like. And we know we haven't seen enough of it. So, let me reintroduce myself and remind you why I'm running.
---

---|---|--- ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/119710692/583977428/-803653937?v=KcgoBQPcImY&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjA4MTkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiM2RiZmRlNjEtZWFjNi1mMDExLTgxOTYtNjA0NWJkZmU4ZTljIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=bzMoKVksJZ2CjcgpmsT-0PM8YKxSpGlPJl0BAIPiPps=&emci=7fd7e975-c1c4-f011-8196-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=3dbfde61-eac6-f011-8196-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=15935548 "Richard Hudspeth for Congress")
Before politics, I was a family physician. For more than twenty years, I've cared for patients across Western North Carolina, from the first cries of newborns to the quiet goodbyes at the end of life. I've been there in hospital rooms and around kitchen tables, helping families through their hardest moments. I also led Western North Carolina's largest healthcare provider, serving nine counties and expanding access to care by more than 400 percent. Before that, I volunteered overseas to help the less fortunate in India and fight the Ebola epidemic in Africa. Service has always been my calling. But here's what I've learned: our healthcare system isn't broken by chance. It's broken by choices—choices made by people in Washington and Raleigh who don't understand how their votes ripple through real lives here at home.That's why I'm running. We need representatives who know what it means to serve, not posture. To listen, not lecture. To solve problems, not score points. We need leaders guided by conviction, grounded in compassion, and inspired by the hard-working people of these mountains. This campaign isn't about me. It's about us. About believing our communities deserve affordable healthcare. That we can build a bigger, brighter future post-Helene. That we must raise wages and lower costs for everyday people.If you believe that too, I'm asking you to stand with me today.

Here are some of her constituents on why they support Emily:** I am endorsing Emily because she makes an honest effort to not only listen to but actually HEAR her constituents! She walks the walk before she talks the talk by literally walking through neighborhoods and knocking on doors, which is, by the way, how I met her. **She knocked on my door and asked me my thoughts and needs.** Now she is holding packed town meetings, ASKING for our input, and USING IT.
_— Terry, Poulsbo_ Emily is really standing up for the values I believe in, **not just parroting our old party lines** for the Dems. We need younger people with new ideas and energy.
_— Jane in Westport_ I am grateful that she is proactive and **very active about things that are important to me** —women’s rights, abortion rights, the sanctity of the law, the detention of innocent people, curbing the unlawfulness of ICE. I feel safe and heard by her advocacy.
_— Pauli on Fox Island_ **Emily’s humane concerns** about conditions in our ICE facility impress me. I wish the governing party demonstrated similar compassion.
_— Marc in Tacoma_ Emily is a smart, compassionate, and **collaborative congressperson** who serves her district and our country. We are so very fortunate to have her represent the people of the 6th District.
_— MJ in Port Townsend_ Emily’s **actions truly speak louder** than the empty political blather we are subjected to these days.
_—Peg on Bainbridge Island_ She works hard for constituents and will **think 'outside the box'!** Emily represents the future. She cares about peace, justice for all, and our environment, including the Climate Crisis!
_— Michael in Belfair_ **Emily is willing to talk with everyone** , including non-democrats. She is proactive about meeting with constituents.
_— Steve in Tacoma_ Emily has her priorities right, has an undaunted spirit, which has proven she can accomplish what few people believed possible. **I believe she's just getting started. **

| | Derek,

As we head into the holiday & Christmas season and look toward the start of session in January, I’ve been thinking a lot about why this work matters — not just politically, but personally.
Since the 2020 elections flipped New Hampshire, we have had a Republican trifecta. That wasn’t an accident. It was built on years of effort, discipline, and the trust voters placed in us to lead responsibly and deliver real results.
But success comes with responsibility. And expectations. Granite Staters are watching closely to see whether we take this moment seriously — whether we lead with purpose, stay grounded, and work every day to strengthen our state for the long haul.
That’s why I’m reaching out today.
[This isn’t about crisis or urgency for the sake of urgency. It’s about building the capacity, the infrastructure, and the strength we need to make the most of this unique opportunity — and to protect what we build when the political winds inevitably shift again.](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Fgranitesolutions%2Fdonate/1/0100019aa6f6d0e7-64ae1a5a-f0bb-435f-aca8-fcd64cd6edb3-000000/uhNY-9KzoW88H-7BNi_fG7XQIjc=453)
If we want to lower costs, protect taxpayers, expand opportunity, and keep New Hampshire the Live Free or Die state future generations deserve, we can’t ease off the gas. We have to keep advancing our vision and growing the team that helps make it possible.
[Derek, if you believe in that mission — and in the work ahead — I’m asking you to invest in it today.](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Fgranitesolutions%2Fdonate/2/0100019aa6f6d0e7-64ae1a5a-f0bb-435f-aca8-fcd64cd6edb3-000000/4Q7HaOxz06CmjgrrzYNJ_cbsVYM=453)
Your support makes a direct impact: it keeps us organized, keeps us communicating, and keeps us ready to lead as we head into session.
This is long-term work, and I’m committed to it.
[Thanks for always being in our corner.](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Fgranitesolutions%2Fdonate/3/0100019aa6f6d0e7-64ae1a5a-f0bb-435f-aca8-fcd64cd6edb3-000000/F5sWA5xIKSroQMQaUboSYa6dKJ8=453)

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
NC Newsline: NC House bill would allow elections board workers to be replaced with political hires [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=112125_1&amount=25]
Get this, Team: Opponents of voting rights in North Carolina introduced a sweeping elections bill that, among other steps, would bar election officials from encouraging or promoting voter turnout. This is just the latest and most stark example of a trend among the vote suppressors of opposing even nonpartisan outreach efforts that could boost voting rates.
This bill would also take more than a third of existing nonpartisan staff positions at the state elections office and convert them to jobs for partisan political appointees deeply invested in the results of the elections they would be in charge of. Finally, the measure would add new voting restrictions for military and overseas voters, and ban ranked choice voting.
The bill and proposed ban on promoting turnout “ raises real questions about what democracy means in North Carolina, who really holds the power, who government is answering to ” according to Andrew Garber, a counsel in the nonpartisan Brennan Center’s Voting Rights and Elections Program.
Opponents of voting rights in North Carolina are more focused on expanding and cementing their own power than they are in serving the people and having fair elections. It's just another example of what they'll export around the country if they get away with it here.
This troubling bill has the potential to impact us all, no matter what state we live in. Please step up with $25 or whatever you can today to help us stop voter suppression in North Carolina and across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=112125_1&amount=25]

For decades, the voter suppression movement has taken bills that pass in one state and exported them across the country. The leaders at a sprawling, dark money conservative think-tank have taken credit for it, caught on camera bragging about writing the legislation at their headquarters. For example -- the sweeping suppression bill passed in Georgia in March of 2021 was adapted and passed in states like Texas, Florida, and beyond in the months afterward.
It's all just the latest extreme anti-democracy tactic pioneered by North Carolina vote suppressors over the last decade or so. In 2016, a court found that the state’s voter suppression law targeted Black voters with “surgical precision.” They drew multiple gerrymandered maps, and stripped the new governor of several election-related powers before he took office. After the 2024 election, they waged a months-long campaign, ultimately unsuccessful, to overturn a Supreme Court race by having over 65,000 valid votes thrown out after the vote-counting, and two recounts, had been completed. It's not going to end until we stop them.

| | Dorian Gray glanced at the picture, and suddenly an uncontrollable feeling of hatred for Basil Hallward came over him, as though it had been suggested to him by the image on the canvas, whispered into his ear by those grinning lips. The mad passions of a hunted animal stirred within him, and he loathed the man who was seated at the table, more than in his whole life he had ever loathed anything. He glanced wildly around. Something glimmered on the top of the painted chest that faced him. His eye fell on it. He knew what it was. It was a knife that he had brought up, some days before, to cut a piece of cord, and had forgotten to take away with him. He moved slowly towards it, passing Hallward as he did so. As soon as he got behind him, he seized it and turned round. Hallward stirred in his chair as if he was going to rise. He rushed at him and dug the knife into the great vein that is behind the ear, crushing the man’s head down on the table and stabbing again and again. There was a stifled groan and the horrible sound of some one choking with blood. Three times the outstretched arms shot up convulsively, waving grotesque, stiff-fingered hands in the air. He stabbed him twice more, but the man did not move. Something began to trickle on the floor. He waited for a moment, still pressing the head down. Then he threw the knife on the table, and listened. He could hear nothing, but the drip, drip on the threadbare carpet. He opened the door and went out on the landing. The house was absolutely quiet. No one was about. For a few seconds he stood bending over the balustrade and peering down into the black seething well of darkness. Then he took out the key and returned to the room, locking himself in as he did so. The thing was still seated in the chair, straining over the table with bowed head, and humped back, and long fantastic arms. Had it not been for the red jagged tear in the neck and the clotted black pool that was slowly widening on the table, one would have said that the man was simply asleep. How quickly it had all been done! He felt strangely calm, and walking over to the window, opened it and stepped out on the balcony. The wind had blown the fog away, and the sky was like a monstrous peacock’s tail, starred with myriads of golden eyes. He looked down and saw the policeman going his rounds and flashing the long beam of his lantern on the doors of the silent houses. The crimson spot of a prowling hansom gleamed at the corner and then vanished. A woman in a fluttering shawl was creeping slowly by the railings, staggering as she went. Now and then she stopped and peered back. Once, she began to sing in a hoarse voice. The policeman strolled over and said something to her. She stumbled away, laughing. A bitter blast swept across the square. The gas-lamps flickered and became blue, and the leafless trees shook their black iron branches to and fro. He shivered and went back, closing the window behind him.

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Thank you.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20251121-5643-footer&t=1&akid=5643%2E420207%2En97YS6)
Peter,
I wanted to personally reach out to say _thank you._ Over the last few weeks my campaign has been raising funds to buy meals for families in need at the White Center Food Bank here in Seattle.
When we first launched this initiative, we set a goal of raising $2,500 to buy 1,000 meals before Thanksgiving. And within 24 hours, we had already exceeded that original goal.
So then we set a new one: $9,000 to buy 3,600 meals before Thanksgiving. And thanks to the incredible generosity of this grassroots community, we’ve just met our new goal.
**That means _thousands_ of people right here in Seattle will be receiving meals this holiday season as a result of your support.**
It means a lot to me to know that we can make such a big difference in our community together. There aren’t many members of Congress who use their campaigns to raise funds for community aid initiatives like this, but to me, that’s what grassroots organizing is all about.
So thank you again, Peter, for your support. And if you’re looking for even more ways to help, make sure to stay tuned for news on another initiative we’ll be launching this winter!
In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal

name: Team GIFFORDS
subject: SIGN ON: Tell Congress and the IRS to revoke the NRA’s tax-exempt status
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
It’s against the law for charitable organizations to conduct themselves in the way that the NRA has.
#

Remember the NRA’s 2019 corruption scandal?
The New Yorker and The Trace conducted an in-depth investigation and revealed the organization’s severe financial mismanagement in a major report. They found that top NRA executives were using NRA funds for their own personal benefit and evading IRS regulations.
Just days before his corruption trial was set to begin, NRA CEO Wayne LaPierre announced his resignation from his position.
Even though the NRA’s corruption was revealed in these investigations six years ago, the NRA _**still_** holds tax-exempt status to this day.
It’s against the law for charitable organizations to conduct themselves in the way that the NRA has. The NRA doesn’t deserve its tax-exempt status.
[**If you agree, will you add your name to our petition to call on Congress and the IRS to revoke the NRA’s tax-exempt status?**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/nov25-NRATAX_sv/?source=em251121-1-b&refcode2=11053.3935704.ul8s-a&akid=11053%2E3935704%2Eul8s-a)

Thank you for taking a stand. With Wayne LaPierre’s resignation and membership at record lows, the NRA is the weakest it’s ever been. Now is the time to finally end the gun lobby’s toxic influence on our political system.
— The GIFFORDS Team

Gabby Giffords has led the fight against the gun lobby for more than a decade, but she can't do it alone.

subject: Let's show these Republican bigshots that we're not scared

body:
If we don’t get off our butts and help Chris Pappas right now, we can kiss the Senate majority goodbye.
Folks, it’s James Carville.
I’ve been around the block a few times and worked on a heck of a lot of campaigns. So believe me when I tell you: **This ain’t good.**
John Sununu — yeah, _those Sununus_ — jumped into the U.S. Senate race in New Hampshire. And now the political eggheads have DOWNGRADED Democrats’ chances of winning there.
**[💥 Before you read another word, chip in $10 or whatever you can to help Chris Pappas fight back right now.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/221?c0=em_ms_cp_20251121_1_carville.F9tgDN&refcode=em20251121-1&t=1&akid=3612%2E582294%2ELEkd0a)**
Let me tell you what this means: **If we don’t get off our butts and help Chris Pappas right now, we can kiss our chances of winning back the Senate majority goodbye.**
This isn’t some back-bench, no-name guy we’re up against. **Sununu’s won a Senate seat before.**
He’s got name ID, deep pockets, and Wall Street’s dark money machine ready to drown us in attack ads. This is the far-right’s big play, y’all — they know if they take New Hampshire, Democrats have _no viable path_ to flipping the Senate.
Chris Pappas is the real deal. I mean it. He’s won the toughest district in New Hampshire four damn times, and he knows how to bring folks together. But he cannot — **_cannot_** — do this alone.
So here’s what I need from you:
**[Rush a contribution to Chris Pappas today. $10, $25, whatever you can spare. Because if we let the GOP buy this seat for Sununu, we’re gonna be stuck with Republican control for years to come.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/221?c0=em_ms_cp_20251121_1_carville.F9tgDN&refcode=em20251121-1&t=2&akid=3612%2E582294%2ELEkd0a)**

I’m mad as HELL that this race just shifted in the wrong direction — but that means it’s time to get serious. Chris is the only one who can hold this seat, but he needs a hell of a lot more firepower to fend off what’s coming.
Let’s show these Republican bigshots that we’re not scared — and we sure as hell ain’t backing down.
**[Give what you can right now.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/221?c0=em_ms_cp_20251121_1_carville.F9tgDN&refcode=em20251121-1&t=4&akid=3612%2E582294%2ELEkd0a)** Let’s win this damn thing and flip control of the Senate.

Katie Hobbs is neck-and-neck with Republican challengers. Here's what's at stake — and why she needs your support. |
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/119724339/584018970/-1397648958?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20251121_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYmYyOGI4YTAtZjdjNi1mMDExLTgxOTYtNjA0NWJkZmU4ZTljIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=u-GZIdsTCrRPBi0d1VQyWAau6aIKWgHh5ystH7pH55U=)
---
Hi there, A new poll just confirmed what we already knew: the 2026 governor's race is a pure toss-up. **Katie Hobbs is statistically tied with all three of her potential Republican challengers: Andy Biggs, Karrin Taylor Robson, and David Schweikert.** With 13-16% of voters still undecided, this race could go either way. Katie won by _less than one percentage point_ in 2022. We can't take anything for granted in 2026. [**If you’re ready to go, please split a donation between AZ Dems and her re-election campaign.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/119724340/584018971/-1501784862?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20251121_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYmYyOGI4YTAtZjdjNi1mMDExLTgxOTYtNjA0NWJkZmU4ZTljIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=u-GZIdsTCrRPBi0d1VQyWAau6aIKWgHh5ystH7pH55U=) Here's what's at stake: Katie grew up working class in Tempe. When times were tough, her family relied on food stamps. She worked at Burger King, waited tables at Pizza Hut to pay for school, and drove for Uber during the Great Recession. **She knows what it's like to struggle — and as governor, she's delivered.** Katie eliminated the tax on rent. She's helping first-time homebuyers with down payment assistance. She's canceling $2 billion in medical debt for one million Arizonans. She gave 750,000 Arizona families a tax rebate. She repealed Arizona's 1864 abortion ban and protected women and doctors from prosecution. On the border, Katie created a Border Coordination Office, deployed the National Guard, and launched Task Force SAFE — which has stopped over 12 million fentanyl pills and 5,000 pounds of drugs from crossing into Arizona. She hammered out the most consequential Arizona water legislation since 1980 and ended a foreign corporation's unchecked pumping of our groundwater. **This is real leadership: bringing people together and delivering results for Arizona families.** Now look at who she's running against. Andy Biggs called Democrats "domestic terrorists." He lied about healthcare on TV. He tried to impeach federal judges for ruling against Trump. He backed Trump's $300 million White House ballroom while Americans went hungry during the shutdown he enabled. Meanwhile, Karrin Taylor Robson is a wealthy businesswoman and developer who lost the 2022 Republican primary to Kari Lake. She’s said that “President Trump and his policies... are my policies.” She’s already poured over $2 million into her own campaign. [**Will you chip in to help re-elect Katie Hobbs and keep Arizona moving forward?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/119724341/584018972/-1501784862?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20251121_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYmYyOGI4YTAtZjdjNi1mMDExLTgxOTYtNjA0NWJkZmU4ZTljIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=u-GZIdsTCrRPBi0d1VQyWAau6aIKWgHh5ystH7pH55U=) _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation to the Arizona Democratic Party and Adelita Grijalva will go through immediately:_ | | [PITCH IN $10 NOW](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/119724342/584018973/-1501784862?amount=10&express_lane=true&refcode=AU_AZD_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20251121_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYmYyOGI4YTAtZjdjNi1mMDExLTgxOTYtNjA0NWJkZmU4ZTljIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=u-GZIdsTCrRPBi0d1VQyWAau6aIKWgHh5ystH7pH55U=)

name: Movement 4 Freedom
subject: We’re proud to endorse Rashida Tlaib
body:
She’s the kind of leader our movement was built to uplift

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/a6629314fe48/tockcw1cwy-186?e=81ab29c4d2)
---
[|
---](https://movement4freedom.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c20cdecc59106d39c65725a01&id=2dff396773&e=81ab29c4d2)
| | | | | | Peter,
---
| | Today, we are proud to **officially announce our endorsement of Congresswoman Rashida Tlaib** — a leader who doesn’t just speak about justice, but lives it, legislates it, and organizes it hand-in-hand with the people.
Rashida embodies everything it means to be a politivist.
She is rooted in her community.She is grounded in people-first values.She is relentless in her fight for the people.
---
[|
---](https://movement4freedom.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c20cdecc59106d39c65725a01&id=fe77529b8c&e=81ab29c4d2)
| | Rashida has spent her career elevating the voices of those too often pushed to the margins — championing affordable housing, immigrant reform, healthcare for all, and so much more. One of her most courageous moves was **her recent introduction of House Resolution 876,** which calls to explicitly recognize the genocide being committed against Palestinians in Gaza. It also calls on the U.S. to honor its obligations to prevent, condemn, and punish genocide. **That’s not just policy — that’s moral leadership rooted in human rights.**
**Rashida shows us what public service looks like when it’s not transactional, but transformational.**
She legislates with moral clarity. She stands unapologetically for human rights; at home and across the world. And she never forgets where she comes from or who she’s fighting for.
That’s why Politivist Action exists: **to lift up leaders like Rashida,** protect bold progressive seats, and build the infrastructure necessary to find and train the next generation of transformative leaders to fuel people-powered change.
**But we can’t do that without you.**
---
| [JOIN THE MOVEMENT](https://movement4freedom.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c20cdecc59106d39c65725a01&id=615cf3085c&e=81ab29c4d2)
---
| | Your contribution helps elect and support champions like Rashida Tlaib. Together we are building a landscape where justice isn’t a slogan — **it’s a governing principle.**
[If you’re ready to stand with Rashida and stand with this movement, chip in now to help power our work.](https://movement4freedom.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c20cdecc59106d39c65725a01&id=8b37bd3e86&e=81ab29c4d2)
Together, we’re building a future where Politivist who put people first aren’t the exception — they’re the norm.
---
| |
**The Movement for Freedom Team**

name: Mohan Seshadri
subject: We're making history. Our local victories are setting us up for big wins in 2026.
body:
https://www.apipennsylvania.org [https://www.apipennsylvania.org]
Dear Peter,
It's almost election day!
Bucks County residents have an important decision to make when we turn out for election day. Our local officials make up the frontlines of our communities — and the Sheriff and District Attorney are no exception.
Our Sheriff is responsible for keeping our communities safe, and our District Attorney is responsible for representing our community in court. We want to elect local officials that stand with our communities, that represent our interests, and that protect our families and neighbors. That's why we have endorsed Joe Khan for Bucks County District Attorney and Danny Ceisler for Bucks County Sheriff.
THIS WEEKEND: Join us to let our Bucks County neighbors know to make a plan to go and vote, and to vote for our endorsed candidates!

President Trump is calling for me to be hanged.

Trump’s friends in the White House didn’t like that. They accused us of insurrection.

Hi there! 👋 I'm Maria! Proud Michigander, leopard print enthusiast 🐆, artist, and lifelong cheerleader of the INCREDIBLE HALEY STEVENS!
Listen, hun. I know I'm biased. **I** _**am**_**Haley 's mom **♥️. But she is still AMAZING!
Can I go full mom-mode for a minute and brag about my Haley? Because I truly believe she's the perfect person to represent Michigan in the Senate. 👏
Yes, Haley is an accomplished Congresswoman with more get-up-and-go than a '66 Mustang. But to me, she's also the endlessly curious little girl who would read an entire book in an afternoon while wearing some goofy vintage bellbottoms. The one who would talk your ear off as she helped out with our family's small landscaping business. The one who relentlessly asked big questions, dreamed big dreams to help her neighbors, and never, ever quit on anything. 💬📚
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/94dd2ab7-e9c3-4650-af76-8fcf4b12b582?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Even back then, I knew she was something special. But I never imagined she'd grow up to help save hundreds of thousands of Michigan jobs during the auto rescue in the Great Recession - or write laws that are helping to create good-paying jobs for our friends and neighbors.
Haley has literally changed so many people's lives, and I'm just so dang proud.
But it's not just what she's done. It's _how_ she does it.
Haley shows up. She listens. She LOVES Michiganders. She works harder than anyone I know (and that's saying something since I've been hanging out with landscapers since the '70s 💪🌳). And she fights for the things that matter - for working people, for women, for science and innovation, and for a future where families can afford to live and thrive.
We've got some people with big egos in politics these days (don't get me started), but I think what we _really_ need are public servants. People who will get up every day and ask, "What can I do for the people I love?" That's Haley.
So, from one proud mom to all of you in this community: Thank you for believing in my daughter. She's not doing this alone - and she's not in for herself. She's doing it with all of us. _For all of us._
And if you see me out on the trail (I'll be the one with the furry leopard print jacket!), come say hi! I'd love to meet you, give you a mom-hug, and brag even more about my girl! 💙
With love,
Maria**
**(Haley 's mom 💕)

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

name: Cole Strehlow, CEO of The Flyover
subject: A personal note as we push toward 2,000 investors
body:
We're close to a milestone that will shape The Flyover's future--and I'm asking for your help.

---
| | |
---
| |
#
---
Dear _Flyover_ Family,

When I stepped into the role of CEO of _The Flyover_ , I knew I was taking on more than a job--I was taking on a responsibility. Not to investors, not to institutions, but to you: the readers who show up every morning looking for honesty, clarity, and a place where the news is about the facts, not the spin. I believed then--and still believe now--that America deserves a media outlet built on trust and accountability. What I didn't expect was how quickly this community would grow, or how deeply so many of you would care about helping us build something better. Eleven days ago, we set out on an ambitious mission: reach 2,000 reader-investors who believe in trustworthy, independent journalism. Today, we're within striking distance--but we're not there yet. We're close enough to feel the finish line, but far enough that we can't do it without you. If you've been thinking about investing...
If you've been waiting for the right moment...
If you've watched our growth and wondered whether your contribution truly matters... **This is that moment. And yes --your investment matters more now than ever.** Every single reader who has invested so far has helped build something rare in American media: a news outlet owned by everyday people, not corporations or political machines. You've helped us prove that Americans do want news they can trust... and that they're willing to stand behind it. Now we're asking those [who haven't invested yet to help us take the next step](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyskbFu2zAQhp-G2myIR4qqBg5FBW2ulwIdCVY8WmwoUhBPFvL2gRLHU8bM392H--__ezEXG2JIt992Rk0-G4cujJbQmYR7iUiEq7ELriUnG1MmtGXHZSsT5d0aqKE5cX4Cbn4Nfouxf-7zunLaIwKKCjVvlWilbKSoJm0br2T7oxmhq7tGQjuCAgArbOtlg10V9CHmHDhvawA4I1eqA9Wpfw4EeMlkjS5QXs__c0g0oY-v-Y7recxzFfVEtBQmfjIYGAwh3bHQF5MHFsNGsyl5W0dkon_ez0AdYEYXtpmJ_rondKcLumAfaLTzYsMtMdEPH85PkBNhIiZ6H5KNx7Pg5cEI18P2Z7j25sgHTbVqt-whxlBUy2R9m22I7zno-xu5a3gLAAD__99UqYE).

**Why This Milestone Matters** Reaching 2,000 investors isn't just a number on a screen. It's a signal--to the media industry, to cynics, to the people who say unbiased reporting is dead--that readers are ready to build something better. It means we can hire more journalists.
It means we can grow our state editions.
It means we can keep _The Flyover_ independent and fiercely committed to facts. And it means that ordinary Americans--not big donors or corporate owners--will shape the future of this newsroom. **A Moment of Truth** When we started _The Flyover_ , we didn't know whether people would rally around a reader-owned model. We hoped. We believed. But we didn't know. Now, millions read us every morning. Over 1,700 have already invested.
And we are so close to proving that a different kind of media company can exist--and thrive. But to hit 2,000 investors, we need readers like you to take that final step with us. **If You 've Been on the Fence...** Maybe you've wondered whether your investment would truly make a difference. It does. Maybe you thought you'd wait until "later."[ Later is now.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyskbFu2zAQhp-G2myIR4qqBg5FBW2ulwIdCVY8WmwoUhBPFvL2gRLHU8bM392H--__ezEXG2JIt992Rk0-G4cujJbQmYR7iUiEq7ELriUnG1MmtGXHZSsT5d0aqKE5cX4Cbn4Nfouxf-7zunLaIwKKCjVvlWilbKSoJm0br2T7oxmhq7tGQjuCAgArbOtlg10V9CHmHDhvawA4I1eqA9Wpfw4EeMlkjS5QXs__c0g0oY-v-Y7recxzFfVEtBQmfjIYGAwh3bHQF5MHFsNGsyl5W0dkon_ez0AdYEYXtpmJ_rondKcLumAfaLTzYsMtMdEPH85PkBNhIiZ6H5KNx7Pg5cEI18P2Z7j25sgHTbVqt-whxlBUy2R9m22I7zno-xu5a3gLAAD__99UqYE) Maybe you've been reading _The Flyover_ long enough to know we're committed to honesty, fairness, and transparency. If that's earned your trust, I hope you'll join us today. **One Last Push** Will you be one of the readers who helps take us across the finish line? [Invest in _The Flyover_ today](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyskbFu2zAQhp-G2myIR4qqBg5FBW2ulwIdCVY8WmwoUhBPFvL2gRLHU8bM392H--__ezEXG2JIt992Rk0-G4cujJbQmYR7iUiEq7ELriUnG1MmtGXHZSsT5d0aqKE5cX4Cbn4Nfouxf-7zunLaIwKKCjVvlWilbKSoJm0br2T7oxmhq7tGQjuCAgArbOtlg10V9CHmHDhvawA4I1eqA9Wpfw4EeMlkjS5QXs__c0g0oY-v-Y7recxzFfVEtBQmfjIYGAwh3bHQF5MHFsNGsyl5W0dkon_ez0AdYEYXtpmJ_rondKcLumAfaLTzYsMtMdEPH85PkBNhIiZ6H5KNx7Pg5cEI18P2Z7j25sgHTbVqt-whxlBUy2R9m22I7zno-xu5a3gLAAD__99UqYE) Thank you--for reading, for sharing, for believing in what we're building, and for standing with me in this defining moment. With gratitude,

body:
Election News Update from the Grant Institute

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/bc236b2d7d23/grant-report-september-12-12770299?e=c16f400a56)
---
|
---
| | | | | | **What is “Election Day”? The Supreme Court Decides in** _**RNC v. Watson**_ **By Justin Riemer, President, USGI, and Marshal Trigg, Junior Counsel, USGI**
Last week, the Supreme Court granted certiorari in [_Republican National Committee v. Watson_](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=396c6877c4&e=c16f400a56) , teeing up a pivotal question about federal election law: Does federal law require mail-in ballots to be received by Election Day, or only marked and submitted __ by that date?
At stake is Mississippi’s practice—[shared by 15 other states and D.C.](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=8375f02d32&e=c16f400a56)—of counting ballots that arrive after Election Day so long as they were mailed on or before that date. Mississippi’s statute, adopted as a temporary COVID-era accommodation and later made permanent, allows ballots postmarked by Election Day to be counted if received within five business days afterward.
The case centers on the interpretation of three federal statutes—[2 U.S.C. § 7](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=27999623de&e=c16f400a56), [2 U.S.C. § 1](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=d993bb00b8&e=c16f400a56), and [3 U.S.C. § 1](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=aacbeb6ee9&e=c16f400a56)—which set a specific “election day” designated on the Tuesday after the first Monday in November in every even numbered year.
The Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals [agreed](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=7223f7b8a4&e=c16f400a56) with the RNC and Judicial Watch (suing on behalf of the Libertarian Party of Mississippi) that the state law violates these federal statutes. They read these provisions strictly: “the election” occurs on a single day, and federal law requires that all votes be cast—meaning received—on that day. In essence, the ballot box is closed. Allowing ballots to arrive days later, they argue, effectively extends “the election” beyond the date Congress prescribed.
The State of Mississippi and intervenors counter that the “election day” refers to the date ballots must be cast, and define “casting” a ballot as the voter’s act of marking and submitting it, not its physical receipt by election officials.
Whatever one thinks of the RNC’s ultimate chances of success, the argument is far from frivolous (or “[bonkers](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=ce01ebbc18&e=c16f400a56)”). The statutory text, lacking any definitions, is genuinely ambiguous, and the plaintiffs have identified a plausible reading that deserves careful consideration.
For decades, election law has been shaped by aggressive legal theories advanced primarily by progressive litigants and advocacy groups. Consider the recent resurrection of the Materiality Provision of the Civil Rights Act of 1965, a law aimed at preventing literacy tests for voter registration, but that progressive groups have now invoked to challenge state requirements for witness signatures, dates on ballot envelopes, and other administrative prerequisites. Such theories, once novel, have gained traction in certain jurisdictions.
Litigants cannot be faulted for advancing interpretations they believe are compelled by statutory text, even when those interpretations challenge conventional wisdom. That’s precisely what the adversarial system is designed to do: test the boundaries of legal doctrine and force courts to grapple with ambiguities in the law. The RNC’s arguments may be aggressive, but they’re grounded in a plausible reading of federal statutes that many judges take seriously, including obviously the Supreme Court justices since they agreed to hear the case.
Further, the concerns about extended receipt deadlines are substantial. They can delay results, create windows where chain-of-custody becomes more difficult to monitor, and complicate post-election litigation. When races are close and ballots continue arriving for days, opportunities for confusion increase and public confidence can erode. The longer ballots remain in transit or in the custody of the postal system, the more difficult it becomes to maintain the kind of tight security protocols that build public trust. (Not surprisingly, a [recent poll](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=c0152b8a22&e=c16f400a56) released by Honest Elections Project found that 89% of registered voters believe that every ballot should be received by Election Day).
And the impacts of election day delivery deadlines are almost certainly exaggerated. Estimates on the numbers of ballot rejections should the grace period end assume voters won’t adjust to an earlier deadline. Even if Mississippi prevails at the Supreme Court, states should strongly consider moving to an Election Day receipt deadline. Ohio appears poised to do so, with its legislature sending such a [bill](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=cb786c675f&e=c16f400a56) to Governor DeWine’s office this week. Kansas, Utah, and North Dakota also enacted legislation this year to move to an Election Day deadline.
---
|
---
| | [Ballotpedia](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=6b8b56df34&e=c16f400a56) reports that twenty-three states have amended their absentee/mail-in voting laws so far this year, including Maine which adopted three bills modifying their policies. [Ballotpedia](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=70e22b3b5e&e=c16f400a56) reports that twenty-three states have amended their absentee/mail-in voting laws so far this year, including Maine which adopted three bills modifying their policies.
**Alaska**
Anchorage [city officials](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=2f509f5c16&e=c16f400a56) (paywall) have clarified that rather than a brand-new “vote-by-phone” experiment, they will be offering a document portal that lets preapproved voters (like those overseas or isolated) submit their ballots electronically. Election leaders say nothing is changing for the 2026 municipal election. In the [April 2025 municipal election](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=71d84aa93e&e=c16f400a56), about 136 out of more than 60,000 ballots were submitted via that portal. Applications to use the portal must be submitted before Election Day, and once submitted, voters receive a PIN to submit their completed ballot online.
**Arizona**
Maricopa County election officials discovered [2,288 ballots misplaced](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=e59c33284c&e=c16f400a56) after Election Day that were left in sealed transport boxes in a drop box by mistake. A [bipartisan team secured the boxes](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=d658e02ea6&e=c16f400a56), verified signatures, and began processing the ballots for counting. Almost all of the ballots were ultimately counted, though 30 required “curing” and 16 were not counted due to unverifiable signatures or unreachable voters.
**Colorado**
The office announced a [public meeting](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=ac8f60f4fa&e=c16f400a56) to establish the random seed for the state’s risk-limiting audit software tied to the November 4 general election, fulfilling requirements under Election Rule 25.2.2(i). The Department of State announced that counties began the formal [tabulation of ballots](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=e72e7532a7&e=c16f400a56) from the November 4 Coordinated Election on Tuesday, November 18. The bulletin noted that under state rules the official results cannot be certified until the risk-limiting audit process (including public random seed generation and hand count audits) is complete.
**Connecticut**
Secretary of State Thomas addressed a set of issues on Election Day [tied to the deployment of](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=1a7324f7cd&e=c16f400a56) new voting tabulation machines across the state. The state rolled out these new tabulators ahead of the municipal elections, and while many precincts reported smooth operations, some towns encountered delays – specifically due to machine malfunctions, programming challenges, or problems reading ballots.
Election officials will [conduct a post-election audit](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=d1f4d98324&e=c16f400a56) of 32 precincts to check the accuracy of machine tabulations using manually reviewed ballots. The precincts were randomly selected in accordance with state law to ensure independent verification of results after widespread deployment of new electronic vote tabulators. The University of Connecticut’s Center for Voting Technology Research will analyze the audit results, including memory cards from the machines.
**Georgia**
Lawmakers are [debating a switch back](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=012b638e13&e=c16f400a56) from ballot-marking devices (BMDs) to hand-marked paper ballots ahead of the 2026 elections. The state would need about $66 million to buy new printers, scanners, and other equipment, and election officials say they’d need at least six months to implement the change.
**Idaho**
About 300 legally cast ballots in Elmore County [were never counted](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=72765e5c77&e=c16f400a56) in the November 4 election, prompting a state level investigation. The discrepancy was discovered when the number of voters checked in didn’t match the number of ballots tallied. Election officials say there’s no sign of foul play as the ballots exist and are being secured, but they’re launching a full hand count and a review of processes to find what went wrong.
**Iowa**
A federal appeals court [upheld the conviction](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=50b5ad3860&e=c16f400a56) of Kim Phuong Taylor of Sioux City, who in 2023 was found guilty on 52 counts of voter fraud after a jury trial. Prosecutors said she illegally filled out election documents and ballots on behalf of members of the Vietnamese community to benefit her husband’s 2020 campaigns. In April 2024, Taylor was sentenced to four months in prison and four months of home confinement; the appellate court found the evidence sufficient and affirmed the jury instructions were proper.
**Maryland**
Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections (RITE) and American Accountability Foundation (AAF) have [demanded](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=fa8fc49431&e=c16f400a56) that Prince George’s County provide unredacted copies of Ian Andre Roberts’ voter registration records. Roberts was recently arrested by ICE and indicted for falsely claiming he was a U.S. citizen who was eligible to work. He had been serving as School Superintendent of Des Moines, Iowa.
**Massachusetts**
In Cambridge’s recent municipal election, more than 5,300 [ballots were not counted](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=cae24409fd&e=c16f400a56) on Election Day, and a counting error was traced to “test deck” data that was never cleared from the tabulation system. Because of that, the unofficial result initially declared one candidate the winner, but after correction, the lead flipped. The error was discovered during a postelection audit, and there’s a possibility of a full hand recount.
**Michigan**
More than three dozen absentee ballots (37) from Hamtramck [won’t be counted after](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=4527c8eaa8&e=c16f400a56) the Wayne County Board of Canvassers deadlocked over concerns they’d been compromised.
State Republicans are asking the U.S. DOJ to [monitor the state’s 2026 elections](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=c4c984314f&e=c16f400a56) because they argue Secretary of State Benson’s gubernatorial run while overseeing the election.
Mike Rogers, the 2024 Republican Senate candidate, [is now asserting](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=5ccb6bfd4a&e=c16f400a56) that a van full of ballots “showed up” in Detroit early in the morning after Election Day and “swung” the outcome against him.
In Hamtramck’s tight mayoral race, 37 [absentee ballots were found](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=a9b3604c43&e=c16f400a56) after Election Day in the city clerk’s office; they had been opened but never counted. City Clerk Rana Faraj told the Wayne County Board of Canvassers that 37 absentee ballots went [uncounted on election night](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=c5c3ce3932&e=c16f400a56) because they were misplaced.
**Mississippi**
In Jackson County, the [local election commission](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=67fcab9512&e=c16f400a56) is asking voters who received mailed “information cards” to fill them out and return them promptly as those cards are used to verify whether a voter has moved from the address on file. The county estimates it sent about 16,000 such cards and says those failing to respond risk being placed in “inactive” status, meaning they won’t appear in the regular pollbook and may need to vote via affidavit. Changes to voter rolls cannot be processed within 90 days of an election, with a deadline of December 10 for this cycle.
**Montana**
Voters who [failed to write their birth year](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=018bb0855c&e=c16f400a56) on absentee ballot envelopes under a new state law still faced thousands of rejections even though local election officials offered the chance to fix errors through calls, emails or mailed notices.
**Nevada**
Washoe County election officials [moved about 31,000 voter registrations](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=ac6b1bf225&e=c16f400a56) from “active” to “inactive” status after a review found the voters had not responded to verification notices or participated in recent elections. Some civic groups had criticized the county in the past for delayed roll maintenance, and the change marks a new level of cooperation between election officials and outside watchdogs.
**New York**
A report found that New York City agencies [failed to offer voter registration forms](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=512d22b3af&e=c16f400a56) in 84% of client interactions, violating the city’s “ProVoter” law. Many agency staff don’t receive regular training on registration law and translated registration forms are often not provided to non-English speaking clients.
**North Carolina**
The [State Board of Elections](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=2358232115&e=c16f400a56) is undergoing a major leadership shakeup, with five new appointments and two internal promotions effective November 1.
U.S. Attorney Russ Ferguson, says the NC DMV [improperly registered six noncitizens to vote](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=f9ec29d297&e=c16f400a56)[.](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=152dd326c4&e=c16f400a56) In some cases, DMV employees incorrectly marked people as citizens, and in others there was a “system error.” The noncitizens say they had no idea they were registered; many believed they were simply signing a form as part of getting a driver’s license. According to the DMV, its own investigation found “no systemic issues,” and the agency said it plans to improve by providing extra training to its examiners.
**Ohio**
Secretary of State LaRose launched “Eva,” an [AI-powered virtual assistant](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=44a5417999&e=c16f400a56) for election officials that’s trained only on Ohio’s Election Official Manual and the annual election calendar. The goal is to streamline election administration, reduce confusion, and improve efficiency by giving officials an always-available “wonky but reliable” help tool.
Lawmakers have [passed Senate Bill 293](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=a4c607bfb3&e=c16f400a56), which eliminates the “grace period” for absentee ballots - meaning only ballots received by the close of polls on Election Day will be counted, removing the previous post-election window.
**Pennsylvania**
Fallout [continues](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=2de186fe75&e=c16f400a56) from Chester County’s poll book printing error during the November 4 election. The County Commission has been deliberating over 1,400 provisional ballots that procedural errors and has hired an outside law firm to conduct an investigation.
More than 200 municipal races in [Westmoreland County](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=0a367de08d&e=c16f400a56) ended in a dead tie.[ ](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=240c54faaf&e=c16f400a56)The county election board will break the ties using a method called “casting of lots.” The tiebreaker drawings are scheduled to happen on November 24.
The Berks County Board of Elections referred [two serious election day complaints](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=a51bfadcef&e=c16f400a56) to the district attorney for investigation.
In Lackawanna County, a [judge of elections and her son were charged](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=1d424e6f03&e=c16f400a56) with election-fraud related crimes after investigators found multiple ballots had the judge’s name written in the space for “judge of elections” before the ballots were handed to voters.
**South Carolina**
Law enforcement has [launched an investigation](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=94b3a8ecde&e=c16f400a56) into some poll managers in Spartanburg County for possible conflicts of interest.[ ](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=4ddf6a5f38&e=c16f400a56)Officials say the county’s Poll Managers Handbook prohibits poll workers from being a candidate — or closely related to one (spouse, parent, sibling, etc.) — at a precinct where that candidate is on the ballot.[ ](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=6d1288dddb&e=c16f400a56)The workers connected to the allegations have been removed from their roles for now and could be terminated depending on the investigation outcome.
**Texas**
Texas counties are [grappling with ballot errors](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=8c260b4132&e=c16f400a56) following the rollout of the newly overhauled TEAM (Texas Election Administration Management) system during the November 4 election. In some precincts, the system mis-assigned voters to sub precincts created by TEAM, which caused people to either lose access to certain ballot issues or be able to vote on issues where they shouldn’t have. County officials say these problems stemmed from an “unready” system launch and are now planning to clean up precinct boundaries and ranges before the next election.
**Utah**
A judge in Utah indicated she will issue a ruling “on or before” November 10 regarding a [new congressional map](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=eee1bc8d14&e=c16f400a56) drawn by the state Legislature. The Legislature’s map, approved after the previous map was struck down, is being challenged by the League of Women Voters of Utah and other groups who argue the redrawing still improperly favors Republicans. The outcome is critical because the new map must be in place for candidate filings ahead of the 2026 midterm elections.
**Wyoming**
A Weston County Clerk has [pleaded not guilty](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=446208ff09&e=c16f400a56) to a [misdemeanor charge](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=48e9ffe929&e=c16f400a56) for failing to appear at a September legislative subcommittee hearing. The subpoena was part of an investigation into ballot printing errors and vote miscounts during the November 2024 election. If convicted, the clerk could face up to six months in jail and a $100 fine.
**Wisconsin**
Washington County Executive Josh Schoemann (a GOP candidate for governor) has laid out a [“Secure Elections Agenda”](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=5990db5294&e=c16f400a56) that calls for dissolving the state’s Elections Commission and transferring its duties to a single elected official.[ ](https://grantdemocracy.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e037df946273cbd1eaa641b78&id=2696bdee09&e=c16f400a56)He also wants to eliminate drop boxes, stop using central count facilities (so ballots are counted where they’re cast), and move all statewide elections to November. As part of his plan, he proposes cleaning up voter rolls to remove inactive or ineligible registrations.
